title: WeHo 3 Stry Townhome w Roof Deck
description:
This is one of 4 2021 built townhomes in the heart of the Wedgewood Houston neighborhood; Nashville's hottest new area, bustling with bars, restaurants, breweries, and coffee shops! This 1 BD/2BA townhome includes 3 FLOORS of living space. The home has a fully stocked kitchen, KING SIZE BED, washer/dryer, & PRIVATE ROOFTOP DECK! The townhome is 4 mins walk to The Truth and only 8 MINS DRIVE TO BROADWAY!

The space
*2021 built 3 Story Townhome in Wedgewood-Houston 
*Walkable neighborhood
*20 Bars, Restaurants, Shops within walking distance!
*8 mins drive (2 miles) to Broadway, Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium
*12 mins drive from Nashville International Airport
*First come first served parking pad with 2 spaces. Paid lot next door. Free street parking. 
*Private ROOFTOP DECK with outdoor furniture and TV!
*High speed WiFi!
*Designed & furnished by Abby Gordon Designs
*Remote controlled string lighting
*Plush memory foam KING SIZED bed
*Fully stocked gourmet kitchen
*12 cup drip coffee maker
*Dishwasher, Stove, Oven, Refrigerator, Freezer
*High-end local Barista Parlor coffee provided!
*Cookware, dishes, utensils, baking sheets, kettle
*TVs on each floor
*Washer/Dryer
*Detergent provided!
*Iron & Ironing Board
*Shampoo, Conditioner, Body Wash
*Hairdryer
*2 full bathrooms!
*Walk in shower w/ hand shower
*High tech mini split AC/Heat unit on every floor
*Hotel luxury sheets, towels, and linens
*High end furnishings from Article
*Hardwood floors throughout
*Queen sized air bed 
*Brick construction
*Private entrance 
*Everything is BRAND NEW!
*Responsive host
*Perfect for couples getaway!
*View the other 3 listings in the building: 
50916580, 50916161, 50618540
*Uber, Lyft readily available!

Guest access
Guests will have access to their entire private townhome unit in the building of 4 units. Other units are 50916580, 50916161, 50618540 (just replace the numbers after /rooms in the address bar)

**PARKING IS FIRST COME, FIRST SERVED. We have 3 options for parking. We have a parking pad located off the back alley for 2 cars(we have 4 units in this building, so we can’t guarantee availability), we have free street parking in front of our building on the street, and there is a paid lot next door.
